body.name: Positive exact-uniform fuzzy family
body.construction: For \(s\in\{-1,1\}\) and \(\lambda\in\{-1,1\}^k\), use \(D_{\mathrm{fuz}}\), \(\pi_\lambda\), \(m_{s,\lambda}\), \(\tau_s\), \(\mu_{0,s,\lambda}\), and \(\mu_{1,s,\lambda}\) as declared. Under \(P_{s,\lambda}\), draw \(X\) uniformly, draw \(A\mid X\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\pi_\lambda(X))\), and draw a binary \(Y\mid A,X\) with the displayed arm mean, with independent potential outcomes supplying consistency.
